steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Researching artists means understanding their CONTEXT — when, where and why they worked, not just what they made. | Key Fact: Critical analysis involves describing, analysing, interpreting and evaluating — move beyond I like it because it looks nice. | Key Fact: Key movements: Renaissance (realism, perspective), Impressionism (light, colour), Cubism (multiple viewpoints), Surrealism (dreams, subconscious), Abstract Expressionism (gesture, emotion), Pop Art (popular culture). | Key Fact: Your artist research should DIRECTLY inform your own work — do not just copy, respond and develop ideas.

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: Create a series of experimental studies exploring artists and art movements. Annotate your process. | Research an artist or designer who works with artists and art movements. Write a critical analysis of their approach and explain how it has informed y | Evaluate the effectiveness of your experiments with artists and art movements. Which approaches were most successful and why?
